name: AK13A - Portable Breathalyser & Alcohol Tester (Breath Alcohol), 99-Record Memory Log
highlights: Ten Seconds to Warm Up, Six to Blow — A complete test inside twenty seconds. Anything slower and people stop using it, which is the actual failure mode of a personal breathalyser.
Stores 99 Readings — The device keeps its own log, so a fleet manager or a bar operator can review rather than rely on being told.
53 Grams, 18.3 mm Thick — Slim enough for a glovebox, a handbag or a uniform pocket.
150 mAh, USB-C — About an hour to charge; sized for occasional use rather than continuous operation.
100 Per Carton, 195,000 Per 20 ft — The highest container quantity in the catalogue by a wide margin — the line to quote for promotional or corporate volume.
